content: XDG config in Go: adrg/xdg is the standard library. xdg.SearchConfigFile('appname/config.toml') locates existing config. xdg.ConfigFile creates path. Works on Linux/macOS (XDG_CONFIG_HOME) and Windows (Known Folders). Combine with BurntSushi/toml for TOML parsing. Pattern: load at startup, pass config struct into bubbletea model with keybinding overrides.
